notes.title: Ending Support & Going Free
notes.content:
[h1]Ending Support[/h1]
A few bugs have cropped up recently with Chambered's Steam Achievement integration. Unfortunately, I no longer have the bandwidth to explore these issues when they come up so I have made the decision to officially end support for Chambered.

[h1]Going Free[/h1]
I wouldn't feel good about charging money for a product I no longer intend to support. This leads me to 2 options:

1. Retire Chambered and remove it from Steam.
2. Leave Chambered on the store, but make it free.

In the last few weeks I have received some very positive feedback about this little game. Players are still getting entertainment out of it, and all reported bugs have been pretty minor. Nothing game-breaking. So here's the deal:

In the coming weeks [b]I will be making Chambered 100% free[/b], but I will no longer provide any support for the title. Please consider this when making a purchasing decision.

Thank you to everyone for playing Chambered, and thank you so much for all the positive and constructive feedback. I've learned a lot in the process (namely that your game gets a support Forum you should check!) and am looking forward to delivering something even better in the future.

Thanks again,
BorVorius
